en: Black-and-white postcard view over an elegant spa town street lined with ornate historic buildings, shops, and hotels along a river or canal. In the foreground stand stone statues holding fruits and garlands on a balustrade. Vintage cars drive along the riverside road, and wooded hills rise behind the town. Printed text at the bottom identifies the place as Karlsbad and indicates the view is from the Mühlbrunn.
